mapper.select: SELECT auth.username, auth.password, auth.email, auth.display_name, auth.enabled, auth.created_at, auth.updated_at, ug.id as group_id, ug.group_name, ug.authority, ug.is_system_group FROM ( SELECT * FROM authentications ORDER BY username LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ) as auth LEFT JOIN user_group_mappings as map ON auth.username = map.username LEFT JOIN user_groups as ug ON map.group_id = ug.id ORDER BY auth.username, map.group_id
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM authentications WHERE username = #{username})

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT auth.username) FROM authentications auth INNER JOIN user_group_mappings map ON auth.username = map.username INNER JOIN user_groups ug ON map.group_id = ug.id WHERE auth.enabled = true AND ug.authority = 'ADMIN'

SELECT auth.username, auth.password, auth.email, auth.display_name, auth.enabled, auth.created_at, auth.updated_at, ug.id as group_id, ug.group_name, ug.authority, ug.is_system_group FROM authentications as auth LEFT JOIN user_group_mappings as map ON auth.username = map.username LEFT JOIN user_groups as ug ON map.group_id = ug.id ORDER BY auth.username, map.group_id

SELECT auth.username, auth.password, auth.email, auth.display_name, auth.enabled, auth.created_at, auth.updated_at, ug.id as group_id, ug.group_name, ug.authority, ug.is_system_group FROM authentications auth LEFT JOIN user_group_mappings map ON auth.username = map.username LEFT JOIN user_groups ug ON map.group_id = ug.id WHERE auth.username = #{username} ORDER BY map.group_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO authentications ( username, password, email, display_name, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{password}, #{email}, #{displayName}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE authentications SET password = #{password}, email = #{email}, display_name = #{displayName}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, enabled = #{enabled} WHERE username = #{username}
